test.subject: seiran — Test email
test.body: This is a test email sent from the seiran admin panel. If you received it, your SMTP settings can send email.

verifyEmail.subject: seiran — Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body:
Welcome to seiran.

Click the link below to confirm your email address:

{{url}}

This link is valid for 24 hours.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

emailChange.subject: seiran — Confirm your new email address
emailChange.body:
seiran — We received a request to change your email address.

Click the link below to confirm the change to this email address:

{{url}}

This link is valid for 24 hours.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

totpDisable.subject: seiran — Request to turn off two-factor authentication
totpDisable.body:
seiran — We received a request to turn off two-factor authentication (TOTP).

Click the link below to turn off two-factor authentication for this account:

{{url}}

This link is valid for 1 hour.

If you didn't request this, ignore this email (two-factor authentication stays on unless the link is opened).

passwordReset.subject: seiran — Reset your password
passwordReset.body:
seiran — We received a request to reset your password.

Click the link below to set a new password:

{{url}}

This link is valid for 1 hour.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

atpLoginCode.subject: seiran — Sign-in confirmation code
atpLoginCode.body:
seiran — Here is your sign-in confirmation code.

To finish signing in with your AT Protocol client (such as the official Bluesky app),
enter the following code:

{{code}}

This code is valid for 15 minutes.

If you didn't try to sign in, you can ignore this email.

plcOperationCode.subject: seiran — Confirmation code for changing your DID information
plcOperationCode.body:
seiran — We received a request to change the management information of your DID (for example, to move to another server).

Enter the following code in the client you are using:

{{code}}

This code is valid for 15 minutes.

If you didn't request this, ignore this email (your DID information won't change unless the code is entered).

action.awaitingUserConfirmation: You have already entered the confirmation code. Please do the final check on the migration screen. After migrating, you will no longer be able to sign in on your original server (such as bsky.social), and your handle will change. Review the details and press "Migrate" to complete the migration.
action.awaitingPlcToken: Enter the confirmation code sent by your original server (such as Bluesky) on the migration screen. The code expires 15 minutes after it arrives, but you can get a new one with "Resend the code" on the migration screen.
action.awaitingSourcePassword: You signed in to your original server with an app password, so the steps needed for the migration could not be completed. On the migration screen, enter the password you use to sign in to your original server (not an app password).
action.error: An error occurred during the migration and it has stopped. On the migration screen, choose whether to retry, or to cancel and start over with a different account or a regular sign-up.

inputWait.subject: seiran — Migration from Bluesky: waiting for your input

expiryWarning.subject: seiran — Your migration from Bluesky will be canceled soon

expired.subject: seiran — Your migration from Bluesky has been canceled
expired.body:
Your migration from Bluesky to seiran (username "{{username}}") was canceled because the deadline passed without any input. The username "{{username}}" that was reserved for you has been released.

Nothing has changed on your original account. If you want to migrate, please start again from the beginning.
